timeline.event: Early Homo sapiens live at Jebel Irhoud
timeline.label: c. 300,000 years ago

timeline.event: Augustus makes Juba II king of Mauretania
timeline.label: 25 BCE

timeline.event: Tariq ibn Ziyad crosses from North Africa into Iberia
Idris I founds the Idrisid dynasty
Fatima al-Fihri founds the al-Qarawiyyin mosque in Fez
The Almoravids found Marrakesh
timeline.label: c. 1070

timeline.event: Ibn Battuta is born in Tangier
Portugal's King Sebastian dies at the Battle of the Three Kings
A Moroccan army defeats the Songhai Empire at Tondibi
Moulay Ismail begins his long reign and builds up Meknes
Morocco recognises the independence of the United States
Kaiser Wilhelm II lands at Tangier, sparking a crisis
The Treaty of Fez makes most of Morocco a French protectorate
Abd el-Krim's Rif fighters defeat Spain at the Battle of Annual
Roosevelt and Churchill meet at the Casablanca Conference
Morocco regains its independence
Casablanca's Hassan II Mosque is completed
The Marrakesh Agreement creates the World Trade Organization
Mohammed VI accedes to the throne
Africa's first high-speed railway opens from Tangier

places.name: Marrakesh
places.clue: The 'Red City' was founded around 1070 and centres on the lively Jemaa el-Fna square.

places.name: Rabat
places.clue: Morocco's capital stands at the mouth of the Bou Regreg river, facing its twin city of Salé.

places.name: Fez
places.clue: Its walled medina, Fes el-Bali, is one of the world's largest car-free urban areas.

places.name: Tangier
places.clue: Birthplace of Ibn Battuta, this port looks across the Strait of Gibraltar to Spain.

places.name: Hassan II Mosque
places.clue: Casablanca's great mosque stands partly over the Atlantic, with a minaret about 210 m tall.

places.name: Chefchaouen
places.clue: This Rif mountain town is famous for its streets and houses washed in shades of blue.

places.name: Aït Benhaddou
places.clue: A UNESCO-listed mud-brick ksar on an old caravan route, seen in 'Gladiator' and 'Game of Thrones'.

places.name: Erg Chebbi
places.clue: Saharan dunes rising around 150 m beside the village of Merzouga.

places.name: Volubilis
places.clue: Ruins of a Roman-era city near Meknes, still floored with colourful mosaics.

places.name: Jbel Toubkal
places.clue: At 4,167 m, the High Atlas summit is the highest peak in North Africa.

places.name: Lixus
places.clue: Phoenician and Roman ruins above the Loukkos river near Larache, linked in legend to the Garden of the Hesperides.

places.name: Legzira Beach
places.clue: Red sandstone arches stand on this Atlantic beach north of Sidi Ifni; one famously collapsed in 2016.
